نبذة

Cosmetic and skin specialists located in Alkimos specialising in advanced skin, body and beauty treatments to maximise your results. All our therapists are extremely knowledgable and friendly with over 50 years experience combined, you are in the safest hands. Services include indulgent facials, corrective dermal peels, MesoFusion skin needling, microdermabrasions and hydradermbrasions, dermaplaning, teeth whitening, IPL hair removal and photo rejuvenation and cosmetic medicine including anti-wrinkle injections, dermal fillers & PDO Threads. Monthly memberships and packages also available.

Best in Class

بناءً على 2,979 مراجعة رائعة من العملاء

Rather than a one-size-fits-all approach, The Skin Edit - Alkimos is praised for thoughtful, personalised skin care shaped around each client’s needs. The team’s knowledge and clear explanations help clients feel comfortable exploring options, with bespoke facials, skin needling and IPL among the treatments delivered with attentive care, leaving each visit feeling reassuring and tailored.
